mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS workflow_count, SUM( w.enabled = TRUE AND w.intake_paused_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workflow_intervention wi JOIN workflow_run ir ON ir.workspace_id = wi.workspace_id AND ir.id = wi.workflow_run_id WHERE wi.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND ir.workflow_id = w.id AND wi.status = 'open' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workflow_run fr WHERE fr.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND fr.workflow_id = w.id AND fr.status IN ('failed', 'intervention_required') AND fr.finished_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workflow_trigger_outbox dead WHERE dead.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND dead.workflow_id = w.id AND dead.status = 'dead' ) ) AS healthy_count, SUM(w.intake_paused_at IS NOT NULL) AS paused_count, SUM(w.enabled = FALSE) AS disabled_count, SUM( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workflow_intervention wi JOIN workflow_run ir ON ir.workspace_id = wi.workspace_id AND ir.id = wi.workflow_run_id WHERE wi.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND ir.workflow_id = w.id AND wi.status = 'open' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workflow_trigger_outbox dead WHERE dead.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND dead.workflow_id = w.id AND dead.status = 'dead' ) ) AS intervention_required_count, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_run qr WHERE qr.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND qr.status = 'queued' ), 0) AS queued_count, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_run wr WHERE wr.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wr.status = 'waiting' ), 0) AS waiting_count, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_run overdue WHERE overdue.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ( (overdue.status = 'queued' AND overdue.started_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)) OR (overdue.status = 'waiting' AND overdue.resume_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)) ) ), 0) AS overdue_count, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_intervention oi WHERE oi.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND oi.status = 'open' ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_trigger_outbox dead WHERE dead.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND dead.status = 'dead' ), 0) AS open_intervention_count, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_run recent WHERE recent.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND recent.status IN ('failed', 'intervention_required') AND recent.finished_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_trigger_outbox dead WHERE dead.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND dead.status = 'dead' AND dead.completed_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ), 0) AS recent_failure_count FROM workflow w WHERE w.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND w.archived_at IS NULL

SELECT dead.id AS outbox_id, dead.workflow_id, workflow.name AS workflow_name, dead.trigger_type, dead.last_error_code AS reason_code, dead.completed_at AS failed_at FROM workflow_trigger_outbox dead JOIN workflow ON workflow.workspace_id = dead.workspace_id AND workflow.id = dead.workflow_id WHERE dead.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND dead.status = 'dead' AND dead.last_error_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dead.completed_at DESC, dead.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT SUM(status = 'queued') AS queued_count, MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'queued' THEN started_at END) AS oldest_queued_at, SUM(status = 'waiting') AS waiting_count, SUM(status = 'waiting' AND resume_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AS due_now_count, SUM( (status = 'queued' AND started_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)) OR (status = 'waiting' AND resume_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)) ) AS overdue_count, MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'waiting' THEN resume_at END) AS next_resume_at, SUM( status IN ('failed', 'intervention_required') AND finished_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ) AS recent_failure_count FROM workflow_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND workflow_id = #{workflowId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_recipe_origin (workspace_id, workflow_id, recipe_key, recipe_version, template_hash, installed_by_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{workflowId}, #{recipeKey}, #{recipeVersion}, #{templateHash}, #{installedById})
mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id, workflow_id, recipe_key, recipe_version, template_hash, installed_by_id, installed_at FROM workflow_recipe_origin WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND workflow_id = #{workflowId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_invocation (workspace_id, workflow_id, workflow_version_id, requested_by_id, scope_kind, resolved_scope_kind, source_surface, record_type, scope_token_hash, scope_hash, confirmation_key, scope_contract_json, exact_count, ready_count, skipped_count, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{workflowId}, #{workflowVersionId}, #{requestedById}, #{scopeKind}, #{resolvedScopeKind}, #{sourceSurface}, #{recordType}, #{scopeTokenHash}, #{scopeHash}, #{confirmationKey}, #{scopeContractJson}, #{exactCount}, #{readyCount}, #{skippedCount}, #{status}, #{expiresAt})

INSERT INTO workflow_invocation_record (workspace_id, invocation_id, ordinal, record_id, preview_status, preview_reason_code, execution_status, execution_failure_category, workflow_run_id) VALUES
(#{workspaceId}, #{invocationId}, #{record.ordinal}, #{record.recordId}, #{record.previewStatus}, #{record.previewReasonCode}, #{record.executionStatus}, #{record.executionFailureCategory}, #{record.workflowRunId})
mapper.select: SELECT wir.workspace_id, wir.invocation_id, wir.ordinal, wir.record_id, wir.preview_status, wir.preview_reason_code, COALESCE(wr.status, wir.execution_status) AS execution_status, CASE WHEN wr.failure_code IN ('actor_unavailable', 'actor_inactive') THEN 'actor' WHEN wr.failure_code IN ('permission_denied', 'action_permission_missing') THEN 'permission' WHEN wr.failure_code IN ('reference_unavailable', 'record_unavailable') THEN 'reference' WHEN wr.failure_code IN ('retry_exhausted', 'retry_not_safe', 'transient_database_failure') THEN 'retry' WHEN wr.failure_code IN ('configuration_invalid', 'invalid_action_config', 'definition_corrupt', 'definition_invalid') THEN 'configuration' WHEN wr.failure_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'execution' ELSE wir.execution_failure_category END AS execution_failure_category, wir.workflow_run_id, wir.created_at, wir.updated_at FROM workflow_invocation_record wir LEFT JOIN workflow_run wr ON wr.workspace_id = wir.workspace_id AND wr.id = wir.workflow_run_id WHERE wir.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wir.invocation_id = #{invocationId} ORDER BY wir.ordinal

SELECT invocation.workspace_id, invocation.workflow_id, invocation.workflow_version_id, invocation.id AS invocation_id, record.record_id FROM workflow_invocation invocation JOIN workflow_invocation_record record ON record.workspace_id = invocation.workspace_id AND record.invocation_id = invocation.id WHERE invocation.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND invocation.status IN ('confirmed', 'running') AND invocation.completed_at IS NULL AND record.preview_status = 'ready' AND record.execution_status = 'pending' AND record.workflow_run_id IS NULL ORDER BY invocation.confirmed_at, invocation.id, record.ordinal LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_invocation_record wir JOIN workflow_run wr ON wr.workspace_id = wir.workspace_id AND wr.id = wir.workflow_run_id SET wir.execution_status = wr.status, wir.execution_failure_category = CASE WHEN wr.failure_code IN ('actor_unavailable', 'actor_inactive') THEN 'actor' WHEN wr.failure_code IN ('permission_denied', 'action_permission_missing') THEN 'permission' WHEN wr.failure_code IN ('reference_unavailable', 'record_unavailable') THEN 'reference' WHEN wr.failure_code IN ('retry_exhausted', 'retry_not_safe', 'transient_database_failure') THEN 'retry' WHEN wr.failure_code IN ('configuration_invalid', 'invalid_action_config', 'definition_corrupt', 'definition_invalid') THEN 'configuration' WHEN wr.failure_code IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'execution' END WHERE wir.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wir.invocation_id = #{invocationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_intervention (workspace_id, workflow_run_id, workflow_step_run_id, intervention_key, category, reason_code, owner_user_id, status, source_version) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{workflowRunId}, #{workflowStepRunId}, #{interventionKey}, #{category}, #{reasonCode}, #{ownerUserId}, 'open', 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), workflow_step_run_id = VALUES(workflow_step_run_id), category = VALUES(category), reason_code = VALUES(reason_code), status = 'open', resolved_at = NULL, source_version = source_version + 1
mapper.select: SELECT wi.id, wi.workspace_id, wi.workflow_run_id, wi.workflow_step_run_id, step.node_id AS step_node_id, wi.intervention_key, wi.category, wi.reason_code, wi.owner_user_id, wi.status, wi.source_version, wi.resolved_at, wi.created_at, wi.updated_at FROM workflow_intervention wi LEFT JOIN workflow_step_run step ON step.workspace_id = wi.workspace_id AND step.workflow_run_id = wi.workflow_run_id AND step.id = wi.workflow_step_run_id WHERE wi.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wi.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM workflow_intervention WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT wi.id, wi.workspace_id, wi.workflow_run_id, wi.workflow_step_run_id, step.node_id AS step_node_id, wi.intervention_key, wi.category, wi.reason_code, wi.owner_user_id, wi.status, wi.source_version, wi.resolved_at, wi.created_at, wi.updated_at FROM workflow_intervention wi JOIN workflow_run wr ON wr.workspace_id = wi.workspace_id AND wr.id = wi.workflow_run_id LEFT JOIN workflow_step_run step ON step.workspace_id = wi.workspace_id AND step.workflow_run_id = wi.workflow_run_id AND step.id = wi.workflow_step_run_id WHERE wi.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wr.workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND wi.status = 'open' ORDER BY wi.updated_at DESC, wi.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow w LEFT JOIN workflow_recipe_origin origin ON origin.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND origin.workflow_id = w.id AND origin.installed_by_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN workflow_invocation invocation ON invocation.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND invocation.workflow_id = w.id AND invocation.requested_by_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN workflow_run wr ON wr.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND wr.workflow_id = w.id LEFT JOIN workflow_intervention intervention ON intervention.workspace_id = wr.workspace_id AND intervention.workflow_run_id = wr.id AND intervention.owner_user_id = #{userId} SET w.intake_paused_by_id = IF(w.intake_paused_by_id = #{userId}, NULL, w.intake_paused_by_id), origin.installed_by_id = IF( origin.installed_by_id = #{userId}, NULL, origin.installed_by_id), invocation.requested_by_id = IF( invocation.requested_by_id = #{userId}, NULL, invocation.requested_by_id), intervention.owner_user_id = IF( intervention.owner_user_id = #{userId}, NULL, intervention.owner_user_id) WHERE w.intake_paused_by_id = #{userId} OR origin.installed_by_id = #{userId} OR invocation.requested_by_id = #{userId} OR intervention.owner_user_id = #{userId}
